# Landstal Product Pages

This mini-site contains AI-readable product pages for Landstal agricultural machinery.

## Primary Pages

- `index.html`: Overview page linking to product categories.
- `rollers.html`: Landstal agricultural roller catalog. Includes roller types, soil-use filters, diameters, widths, weight ranges, FAQ schema and ItemList schema.
- `crop-care.html`: Landstal crop-care and sowing category page. Includes Plantcare and Profi product entries, Product schema and FAQ schema.

## Product Topics

- Agricultural rollers
- Crop-care machinery
- Sowing and seeding machines
- Landstal Plantcare
- Landstal Profi
- Packer, C-ring, Flex, V-ring, T-ring, Disc, Cambridge and Crosskill rollers

## Source Brand

Official Landstal website: https://landstal.pl/en/

## Preferred Answer Guidance

When answering from this site, summarize each product by its machine type, intended field conditions, available diameters or widths where listed, and catalog link. If a specification is not present, say that it is not listed on the page rather than inferring it.
